page.notes: The Greek words "ἄνομον γάμον" and "ἄνομος" are read from a small, faint scan and are uncertain in their accents and breathings. The word at the line end before "non est" ("cont" in the scan) is uncertain and is read as "consensus"; it could be cut differently. "in" at the lower right is a catchword. The right edge shows show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed.
